bibl.title: P. Oxy. LXXXIV 5476 - Gryllos?
bibl.seg: Martin Reinfelder, P. Oxy. LXXXIV 5476 - Gryllos?
Frammenti sulla scena (online). Studi sul dramma antico frammentario 1 (2020) 7 pp.
bibl.note: P. Oxy. LXXXIV, 5476 (LDAB 832206). - Presents another interpretation of the papyrus by drawing parallels to other pieces, in particular P. Oxy. XXII, 2331 (= MP3 1931; LDAB 5363), which can be collected under the term Grylloi.
